fields.name: compressive_strength_class
fields.rationale: The dataset specifies the concrete is of compressive strength class C8/10, which is a key property for categorizing concrete based on its load-bearing capacity.

fields.name: density
fields.rationale: Density is a fundamental property of concrete that affects its weight and structural performance, explicitly stated as 2400 kg/m³ in the dataset.

fields.name: application_area
fields.rationale: The dataset describes the use of concrete in building construction, civil engineering, and structural engineering, which are common application areas for ready-mixed concrete.
evidence: Concrete is a versatile building material in the construction industry. It is used in building construction, above all for ceilings, walls, stairs, foundations, columns and trusses, in civil engineering for components in contact with the ground, foundations, floor slabs, bored piles and in civil engineering, e.g. for bridges.
inference_basis: Common application areas for concrete include building construction, civil engineering, and structural engineering.
